name: Penelope Aufschub
personality: She can preserve an unfinished matter longer than most authorities can preserve their patience.
biography: Aufschub keeps the HyperNorm household occupied with a weaving frame whose completion would settle rather too much. A card suggesting that delay can be an active decision receives her unequal sideways glare: a task is either finished or still hers. Men in Black request a deadline. She loosens one thread, leaving herself enough room to choose the morning again.
note: Die Arbeit schreitet voran. Ihr Abschluss wurde vorsorglich entnommen.

name: Polyphem Einblick
personality: He finds one clear point of view sufficient until the visitors start explaining themselves.
biography: Einblick guards the HyperNorm pantry with one enormous eye and a cheese wedge held under both hands. A card suggesting that a single perspective may remain incomplete opens his offended mouth: a visitor is either accounted for or taking liberties. Hunky & Dory praise his vigilance. He checks the cheese again, hoping that possession will provide the missing explanation.
note: Der Überblick ist eindeutig. Die Einsicht wird noch festgehalten.

name: Odysseus Umweg
personality: He treats the official route as a useful account of where the difficulties will be waiting.
biography: Umweg approaches the HyperNorm entrance with a bow at his side and a travel pouch that has learned to remain tied. A card proposing that cleverness can prolong the journey earns his smallest crooked smile: a delay is either strategy or somebody else's weather. Men in Black request his destination. He considers whether arriving and being recognised are quite the same assignment.
note: Die Rückkehr ist vorgesehen. Ihre Durchführung nimmt noch den Umweg.

name: Poseidon Gegenstrom
personality: He regards an independent course as a personal criticism of the conditions he has supplied.
biography: Gegenstrom governs the HyperNorm plumbing with a trident whose three opinions are remarkably consistent. A card allowing authority to coexist with an independent course receives his skewed roar: movement is either with him or provocatively across him. Hunky & Dory expect dependable pressure. He grips the shaft tighter, briefly confusing control of the current with an explanation of its direction.
note: Die Strömung ist geregelt. Abweichende Fahrpläne gelten als Widerspruch.

name: Kirke Nachwürze
personality: She offers hospitality with the quiet confidence that the guest will eventually become easier to accommodate.
biography: Nachwürze receives HyperNorm callers with a bronze cup whose pig-shaped handle is a modest hint about her preferred outcome. A card allowing welcome without correction draws her nearly closed smile: a guest is either comfortable or not yet adjusted. Hunky & Dory admire her results. She stirs once more, considering whether the visitor might keep a little of the original flavour.
note: Die Gastfreundschaft ist vorbereitet. Der Gast wird gegebenenfalls angepasst.

name: Aiolos’ Restdruck
personality: He is the promise of favourable conditions trying to keep its own closure from becoming a decision.
biography: Restdruck waits in the HyperNorm service cupboard as a living parcel of conditions somebody promised to keep favourable. A card suggesting that freedom and containment may depend on each other swells his cheeks: the knot is either shut or everything is happening. Men in Black require a controlled release. He holds both ends, unable to decide which hand should receive the instruction.
note: Die Freigabe ist angeordnet. Beide Hände melden weiterhin Zuständigkeit.
